tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Flagship. Returns one public page, named by the caller, as Markdown ($0.003 x402, synchronous, charged only on success). Pay with X-PAYMENT or PAYMENT-SIGNATURE, or prepaid credit. Part of the AutoPay Agent Toolkit.

tools.name: fetch_batch
tools.description: Returns up to 5 public pages, named by the caller, as Markdown in one call ($0.008 per batch, synchronous, charged only if at least one page succeeds). AutoPay Agent Toolkit.

tools.name: wallet
tools.description: Base wallet snapshot ($0.003, synchronous, charged only on success). Read-only. AutoPay Agent Toolkit.

tools.name: erc20_balance
tools.description: Read-only Base ERC-20 balance ($0.003). AutoPay Agent Toolkit.

tools.name: chain_tx
tools.description: Read-only Base transaction lookup ($0.003). Never sends a transaction.

tools.name: chain_gas
tools.description: Read-only Base gas price ($0.002).

tools.name: chain_contract
tools.description: Reads whether an address has deployed bytecode on Base ($0.004). Read-only, never executes.

tools.name: ping
tools.description: Liveness ping ($0.002) returning ok, ts, payer, and price.

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Email syntax, MX, disposable and role flags, SPF and DMARC ($0.002). No SMTP probe. The address is not stored.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Queue a cited web lookup ($0.01). Returns 202 with job_id. Typical ETA 10–20 minutes; poll get_job.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Deep task, 10–20 min. Claim/company/URL verification ($0.08). Returns 202 with job_id; poll get_job.

tools.name: research
tools.description: Deep task, 10–20 min. Short cited brief ($0.30). Returns 202 with job_id; poll get_job.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Poll a previously queued AutoPay job by id until status is done.

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Reads a caller-supplied PDF or image into typed fields, line items, and OCR text ($0.025 per page, max 5 pages billed; synchronous, charged only on success). Pay with X-PAYMENT (x402 USDC on Base) or prepaid credit.

tools.name: security_scan
tools.description: Quick passive security scan: passive, read-only public configuration checks (TLS, HTTP headers, DNS and email records, publicly reachable well-known paths); score and grade. $0.01; synchronous, charged only on success. Pay with X-PAYMENT (x402 USDC on Base) or prepaid credit.

tools.name: security_scan_headers
tools.description: Security headers check: passive, read-only public configuration check of HTTP headers (HTTPS redirect, HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy); score and grade. $0.003; synchronous, charged only on success. Pay with X-PAYMENT (x402 USDC on Base) or pr

tools.name: security_scan_tls
tools.description: TLS certificate check: passive, read-only public configuration check of certificate trust, issuer, subject alternative names, expiry, and the negotiated TLS version; score and grade. $0.002; synchronous, charged only on success. Pay with X-PAYMENT (x402 USDC on Base) or prepaid credit.

tools.name: security_scan_dns
tools.description: DNS / e-mail security check: passive, read-only public configuration check of DNS and email records (SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX, CAA, DNSSEC); score and grade. $0.003; synchronous, charged only on success. Pay with X-PAYMENT (x402 USDC on Base) or prepaid credit.

tools.name: security_scan_exposure
tools.description: Public path check: passive, read-only check of publicly reachable well-known paths; score and grade. $0.005; synchronous, charged only on success. Pay with X-PAYMENT (x402 USDC on Base) or prepaid credit.

tools.name: security_scan_full
tools.description: Full passive security review: passive, read-only public configuration checks (TLS, HTTP headers, DNS and email records, publicly reachable well-known paths), plus cookie flags, mixed content, server disclosure, domain age, up to 5 same-site subpages, and a prioritized remediation plan. $0.99; synchr

tools.name: geo_check
tools.description: On-page GEO check for a public page the caller names ($0.02, synchronous, charged only on success). Pay with X-PAYMENT (x402 USDC on Base) or prepaid credit.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "security_scan_full" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: email_check, security_scan, security_scan_dns, security_scan_full · Private data: wallet, security_scan, security_scan_dns, security_scan_full · Public sink: email_check, security_scan, security_scan_dns, security_scan_full.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: email_check, security_scan, security_scan_dns, security_scan_full · Private data: wallet, security_scan, security_scan_dns, security_scan_full · Public sink: email_check, security_scan, security_scan_dns, security_scan_full

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
